name: promptlike
description: Your PromptLikeEngineer prompt library inside Claude Code: fetch, fill and save prompts, use them as slash commands and @-mentions, and get a local hint when a saved prompt fits what you ask.

suggestions.title: Suggest saved prompts
suggestions.description: Before each message, match it against your saved prompts on this machine and tell Claude when one fits; your message never leaves this machine. Needs the `ple` CLI. Set to false to turn off.
